notes: Nill Download Manager 2.0.0 — a ground-up audit release: the whole app and the browser extension were used end-to-end and read line by line, and what the audit found is fixed here. A path collision that could overwrite an existing file is closed, so a download can no longer lose data; drag and drop onto the main window and the Drop Basket works; transfer rate and time-left figures are the true measured values; downloads are routed into categories truthfully and your own custom categories appear in the categories tree. On Windows, NDM now updates itself from inside the app — one click on Update downloads, verifies and installs the new version and relaunches it, and an update can be marked required so older copies cannot keep downloading until they update — and there is a proper Windows installer (per-user, no administrator rights needed) alongside the portable build, plus a matching update check on Linux. Every fix was verified in live use.
